answer: An oasis admission bond stops bulk fakes with scarce slots. Each member draws three ivory vouch tokens per epoch from the kernel registry, staking 70 credits each; one admits a newcomer to an oasis plot. Auditors replay tokens on the kernel registry: reuse or a fourth vouch burns both bonds; rented rings fail, tokens key-bound. First 40, thousandth 6,034: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
